keyVerseDR: "...he that humbleth himself shall be exalted." (Lk 14:11)

level1.title: Take the Last Seat
level1.story: Jesus saw guests choosing the best seats at a dinner. He said, "Take the lowest seat instead." He said to invite the poor, who cannot pay you back.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: Who can you invite to play?

activity.title: Let others go first
items: Let someone go first in line

level2.title: The Lowest Place
level2.story: Jesus went to dine at the house of a Pharisee on the sabbath, and He noticed how the guests chose the first seats. He said, "When thou art invited to a wedding, sit not down in the first place." Instead, sit in the lowest place, so the host may say, "Friend, go up higher." Jesus said, "Every one that exalteth himself, shall be humbled; and he that humbleth himself, shall be exalted." He told the host to invite the poor, the lame, and the blind, who cannot repay him.
level2.keyLine: He that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Who could you invite who can't repay you?
level2.prayer: Jesus, meek and humble, make me like You. Amen.

activity.title: Humble at Mass
activity.intro: Get to Mass early and pray humbly.
items: Lay out my clothes the night before
Let others take the good seats
